newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures flat to weak.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures flat to weak.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were flat to weaker on Friday in directionless after-hours trade ahead of the spot expiry on Monday, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.3 yen per kilogram lower than the day's close. Benchmark April was 0.1 yen weaker at 142.2 yen. Volume was 4,791 lots.
Prices edged down earlier in the day, pressured by a firmer yen and weaker Thai rubber offer prices to Japan.
"Uncertainty over the spot expiry hindered activity," one trader said.
